headline: TBR @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.64 at BAL 4.34, with a projected total of 8.98. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: TBR moved -1.07 runs while BAL moved +0.30, changing the projected margin by -1.38 runs. The projected total fell -0.77, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +9.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Steven Matz has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Junior Caminero, Chandler Simpson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler O'Neill because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
